token.title: 🔑 Tōken in GitHub
token.intro: GitHub ej uwaak 60 kajjitōk ilo juon awa ñan juon adrej eo ejjab jilkinļọk tōken. Juon wōjke in fork ko aolep ej aikuj bōlen 32, kōn men in ilo ruo alen eo ejjeļọk ļo̧k. Juon tōken ej kōļapļọk jem̧ļo̧k eo ñan 5000 ilo juon awa.
token.step1: Kōpeļọk Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, innām Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: am make akaun. Expiration: jabdewōt raan, wōjke eo ejjab aikuj jabdewōt men ekkeitok.
token.step4: Kwōn jab jibwe jabdewōt kōmālim. Meta in jikin kōjparok ko ñan aolep rejjab aikuj juon iaan er.
token.step5: Kōm̧m̧ane, innām kōpe wōnāān eo {token}. GitHub ej kwaļọk juon alen wōt.
token.classic: Juon tōken etto ej bar jerbal: kōm̧m̧ane juon im jab kāālōt jabdewōt jikin. Ñe ejjeļọk jikin, ej bar riiti kōjjeļā ñan aolep ilo jokkun eo ekōm̧ālim.
token.stays: Ej pād ilo browser in ium̧win ki eo {key} im ej etal ñan {host} wōt. Jamin jeje ilo laajrak in adrej eo, kōn men in juon link kwōj kwaļọk ej bōk kilen lale eo im jab kōmālim eo. Batin eo ium̧win jikin jeje eo ej bar jolok ippān cache eo.
token.persistHow: Likūt tōken eo ilo faiļ in {env} an server eo ej kōpād peij in, iturin {port}:
token.proxy: im jino kōn {make}. Innām kontena eo ej jeje juon nginx eo ej kōbaik header eo {header} ñan juon proxy {path}, kōn men in browser eo ej kūr ñan an make jikin im jamin bōk tōken eo. Jikin jeje in ej jako im aolep ri-lotok rej kōm̧m̧ane juon wōt bajet in 5000 ilo juon awa.
fork.refused404: Ejjeļọk ļain in ra: {message}. Juon 404 ijin ej juon ra eo ejjeļọk ak juon iaļ eo proxy in server eo ejjab bōk; netwōk in fork ko ilōñ ej aolep jekdọọn.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub ejjeļọk an kajjitōk ilo awa in, kōn men in ejjeļọk ļain in ra kwaar kōm̧m̧ani. Netwōk in fork ko ilōñ ej aolep. Kobaik juon tōken ilo peinel in kāālōt, ak kōkkiki ļain in ra ko ilo peinel in wāween bwe bajet eo en ñan netwōk eo wōt.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub ear uwaak {status} kōn bwebwenato in kōmit ko, kōn men in ejjeļọk ļain in ra kwaar kōm̧m̧ani. Netwōk in fork ko ilōñ ej aolep.
